messages:
alex: Heads up — started seeing latency oscillations on qwen-7b-prod after the kernel-selector change at 9:10PT. p95 jumped 2.4x for short periods. Anyone oncall? :eyes:

maria: saw the alert, digging. looks correlated with batch size jumps + frequent KV cache churn. not sure why kernel chooser keeps swapping every ~30s.

jonah: can you paste the profile output? also which kernel variant did it switch to?

alex: here's the perf dump from the Node-17 instance (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-16T09:12:03Z] kernel_selector: fallback->gemm_v2 for model=qwen-7b seq=512
[2026-03-16T09:12:27Z] batcher: adaptive window bumped from 16->48 due to concurrency spike
[2026-03-16T09:12:31Z] kv_cache: eviction pressure high (evict_rate=0.74)
[2026-03-16T09:12:33Z] kernel_selector: gemm_v2->optimized_attention for model=qwen-7b seq=512
[2026-03-16T09:12:59Z] p95_latency_ms: 142 -> 344 -> 160
```

sophie: interesting — optimized_attention has much better throughput at steady state, but worse tail when batch size oscillates. seems the selector is using avg_throughput heuristic and not accounting for tail latency under KV churn.

maria: quick mitigation: pinned kernel to gemm_v2 on qwen-7b pool. rolling patch now (deploy bot will show).

ci-bot: deploy started for patch/pin-qwen-kernel -> pool:qwen-7b (rolling)

jonah: long term we should enhance kernel-selector to consider a tail_latency_score. Current score = alpha*avg_tokens/s + beta*max_mem. Need to add gamma*p95_latency_under_eviction.

alex: agreed. also we discovered some HF config oddities during onboarding that might have amplified head-dim mismatch and kv evictions: the converted safetensors file omitted the original 'num_key_heads' metadata, so the runtime forced fallback mapping -> extra KV entries. maria, can you confirm?

maria: yeah, conversion script (tools/convert_safetensors.py) missed writing 'num_key_heads' for qwen variants with shared heads. quick diff:
```diff
- meta = {k:v for k,v in src_meta.items() if k in allowed}
+ meta = src_meta.copy()
+ meta.setdefault('num_key_heads', src_meta.get('num_heads'))
```

sophie: oh that explains the extra kv slots and eviction pressure. when heads != kv_heads, KV cache shapes inflate. we should add a sanity check during onboarding that validates "kv_dim == hidden_size / (num_key_heads)" and error if mismatch > 2%.

jonah: file an onboarding lint job? maybe run hfconfig-lint in the CI pipeline for new model uploads. Also add an estimator to the profiler: simulate 1k concurrent short requests to see batcher oscillation.

alex: created a short issue: https://rwd/issues/INF-4829 — mitigation pinned, conversion patch landed in PR #3582, and adding kernel-selector gamma term is an RFC.

maria: thanks. i'll follow up with a small perf run after the pinned rollout finishes, and add the hfconfig-lint to the converter CI.

sophie: moving to monitoring playbook: add alert if kernel_swap_rate > 3 swaps/min for a single pool + p95 spike > 2x baseline.

alex: perfect. please also add a tiny reproducer (local) and drop it in tools/profiles/qwen-batch-oscillator. saves time next time. :+1:

ci-bot: deploy finished: patch/pin-qwen-kernel -> pool:qwen-7b (ok)
